_comment: IST-2026 wide search under the six-term objective. The existing trace split is retained unchanged by author decision. The test files were inspected in an earlier experiment, so they are fixed evaluation files rather than a new untouched test set. Training and every model/segment/baseline choice use train+validation only; test evaluation requires an explicit frozen second stage.

lstm._selection_note: The previously validation-selected log1p transform and 128x2 architecture are frozen. Existing segment-specific predictors are reused because the reward and finite-window changes do not alter the LSTM prediction target or observation cadence. Final-test traces were excluded from their training data.

dqn_sweep._selection_note: Screen the prior stable optimizer setting plus the same four deterministic random configurations at each requested segment size for three epochs with seeds 42-44 (paired, low-fidelity comparison). Retrain the best configuration per segment size from scratch for eight epochs on all 12 seeds. Rank the four finalists only by the disjoint training seeds 45-53; checkpoints from all 12 seeds remain for final aggregate testing.

baselines._selection_note: BufferBased and MPC are the primary adaptive non-learning baselines. Their parameters are reselected on validation after the DQN winner fixes the segment size; fixed tiers remain reference policies.

final_eval._note: Uses the unchanged, previously inspected test files only after DQN, segment size, LSTM, and baseline parameters are frozen on validation. The output retains all case-level rows; no choices may be changed after viewing it.
